b.x: For whoever searches ‘72-hour kit’, ‘what to do in the first 72 h’, and ‘emergency backpack’.
01 What is already in the pocket ID, a light, 24 h of meds. The 72 h starts in EDC.
02 72-hour kit Water, no-cook food, paper, shoes that walk. A travel bag.
03 A list to check Tick what you already have. Do not buy the internet inventory.
04 When the lights die The first hours of a blackout are the most common 72 h.
05 First aid Pressure on a cloth, emergency medical number. An official course — not a playlist.
